definitions.explanation: A member of the imperial court nobility in pre-modern Japan. The kuge held positions at the imperial court and were distinguished from the buke (warrior class). Their influence peaked during the Heian period and gradually declined as warrior governments took power.

examples.japanese: {公家|くげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝廷|ちょうてい}→朝廷：13081_choutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕|つか}えた→仕える：11547_tsukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The court nobles served the imperial court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公家|くげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧や⟦{雅楽|ががく}→雅楽：27354_gagaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗜|たしな}んだ。
examples.english: Heian-period court nobles cultivated waka poetry and gagaku court music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武家|ぶけ}→武家：13242_buke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{公家|くげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧な⟦{影響力|えいきょうりょく}→影響力：20040_eikyouryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the warrior class took power, the political influence of the court nobles declined significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
{公家|くげ} is contrasted with ⟦{武家|ぶけ}→武家：13242_buke⟧ (warrior/samurai class). The {公家|くげ} tradition was centered in Kyoto around the imperial court, while ⟦{武家|ぶけ}→武家：13242_buke⟧ power was based in Kamakura and later Edo.

After the Meiji Restoration, many {公家|くげ} families were incorporated into the new {華族|かぞく} (peerage) system.

The word is sometimes read as こうけ, but くげ is the standard reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公家|くげ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{武家|ぶけ}→武家：13242_buke⟧: court nobles and warrior class
- {公家|くげ}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: court noble society
- {公家|くげ}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: court culture
- {公家|くげ}⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧: court noble's mansion
